target.statement: FTM (mean and standard deviation) linear SVM classifier achieves 100% accuracy on the GunPointOldVersusYoung dataset.

compute.basis: The dataset is tiny (a few hundred short series), features are just mean and std, and a linear SVM on 2 features with 30 resamples runs in seconds on a CPU.

title: Never a Dull Moment: Distributional Properties as a Baseline for Time-Series Classification
